decision.observation: The goose stands in front of the closed gate. The latch pipe with curled end protrudes on the gate's top rail near the right post at ~(0.60, 0.455), roughly at beak height when standing. Grabs have made sparkles at it but I've never followed a grip with a separate northward walk click to swing the gate.
decision.hypothesis: Gripping the latch pipe (plain left press on it, no Ctrl) then issuing a separate click on the path beyond the gate will make the goose push/drag the gate open.
decision.memory: Grip persists after press (boot/can stayed held); separate walk clicks then drag/move the grabbed object.
